view.overviewDescription: Records are grouped into labelled circles. A record with a single link is counted on the record it links to, and links are drawn only for the record you point at or select. The panels beside this graph list the same information as text.
view.overviewHelp: Each circle is a group. Hover or tab to a record to see its links; select it to unfold what is counted on it. Arrow keys move within a group, F focuses on a record.
view.focusDescription: The record in focus is at the centre, the records it links to are on the first ring, and the records those link to are on the second.
view.focusHelp: The record in the middle, what it links to on the first ring, and what those link to on the next. Select a record to focus on it or expand it; F focuses, E expands.
view.focusOnHint: Show this record at the centre, with its neighbours in rings
view.expandHint: Also draw this record’s own links, one ring further out
view.more_one: {{formatted}} more record within reach is not drawn — focus on a neighbour to see it.
view.more_other: {{formatted}} more records within reach are not drawn — focus on a neighbour to see them.
view.looseHint: These records point at nothing and nothing points at them. Pick one to see it.
